title: Step from a specified state
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, let $b$ be a choice bit, and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input. If the state component of $c$ is $q$, then one step under choice $b$ is obtained by applying to $c$ the action prescribed by the transition function at $q$, using the input symbol and work-tape symbols scanned in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes
A configuration $c$ on a fixed input
A state $q$ with state component of $c$ equal to $q
